items:
The Second Sandbar - 30A Vacation Rental with Private Pool in Dune Allen Beach
Favorite Features
- Private Heated* Pool with Spa Tub
- Large Patio with Outdoor Kitchen
- Sleeping for 26
- Private Elevator
- Game Room with Pool Table
- Located one block from Gulf Place and Beach Access

More about The Second Sandbar
The Second Sandbar is an expansive, newly remodeled vacation home on Highway 393 close to 30A. This stunning home features three floors of updated, luxurious living space perfect for large families, group getaways, and peaceful retreats. Complete with a game room, private pool, spa tub, and gulf views, guests will have everything they need for a perfect vacation within this gorgeous home. The Second Sandbar is located in Dune Allen Beach, just one block away from the shopping and dining option of Gulf Place and the beautiful emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Upgrade your stay and book this beautiful home for the ultimate vacation getaway!

Arriving at The Second Sandbar, guests are welcomed with spectacular beach house curb appeal near 30A. Four bikes and a golf cart greet guests, in addition to an abundance of parking space. Inside, the first floor of The Second Sandbar is home to a game room, two bedrooms, and a state-of-the-art theater. The game room boasts a pool table, two retro-style arcade games, and an entertainment area with a flat-screen TV and lounging chairs. The game room also overlooks the resort-style backyard and offers access to the pool. The first floor king suite is home to a king-sized bed, an en-suite bathroom, a spacious closet, and a flat-screen TV. Additional sleeping arrangements are located in the first floor bunk room– complete with three sets of built-in twin bunk beds.

Stepping out of the floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors, guests are treated to a private backyard oasis. A covered lanai creates the perfect space for cooking and relaxing. Guests can take advantage of this outdoor area with the stainless steel grill and ample seating both under the lanai or around the pool. Choose between spending the day at the beach or soaking in the home's private pool. The Second Sandbar provides a luxurious paradise inside and outside of the home.

On the second level of this Dune Allen Beach vacation rental, guests are in for a treat with a top-of-the-line kitchen, over 800 sq ft of living and dining space, two additional bedrooms, and a bunk room for children or young adults. The open floor plan on this level creates a spacious environment for entertaining and comfort. The kitchen boasts high-end appliances and a large island with breakfast bar stools. Ample seating is also found in the living room area where two sofas and sofa chairs surround a flat-screen TV. Not to mention, a spacious balcony is located near the main living area offering patio seating, a large flat-screen TV, and views of the backyard. The two bedrooms found on this floor offer king suites with en-suite bathrooms.

The final floor of The Second Sandbar encompasses pure comfort. Four more king suites with en-suite bathrooms offer comfort after spending the day in the Florida sun. Three of the third floor suites include private balconies with cozy patio furniture and incredible views of Dune Allen Beach.

reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: This property is exactly as it is listed. Beautiful!! The pool is stunning especially at night. We had some problems with the pool codes (they are on the box outside). We lost swim time when the pool guy came and changed the settings to HOT. I contacted the property manager who called with no response from the pool guy. Other than that small problem the stay was great. The beach is close the golf cart and bikes were a great plus for moving around the area. The house is clean everything is beautiful. Decor gives mansion, vibes with family warmth. It is very spacious everyone had plenty of room. Bathrooms were very clean. The Second Sandbar is a great place to stay and I would 100% recommend this property as well as visit again. Also the 30A beach area is the best! The water is clear the beaches have beautiful white sand and is very clean. Reserve this house for a Great Time!!
